summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Hostel Management System. 34/34 backend pytest tests passed (auth, students, rooms, staff, fees, attendance, complaints, food menu, dashboard, project PDF, role-based access, cascading deletes, idempotent attendance). Frontend: login + role-tab prefill works, admin can create rooms and students via dialogs, all sidebar navs reachable, logout works, newly-created student can log in and view profile/room/fees/attendance/complaints/food.

ui_bugs.issue: Success toast in top-right (`Welcome, Administrator`, `Room created`, etc.) overlaps the primary action button on the page (e.g. `Add Room`, `Add Student`) for ~5s. Real users could find action buttons unclickable for several seconds after a navigation/login. Only a layering / position issue, no functional break.

action_items: (Optional) Reposition toast container so it does not overlap the primary action button on Rooms / Students / etc., or shorten toast duration. Currently functional but causes a brief unclickable window.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 950+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, students, rooms, fees, attendance, complaints, food, pdf) for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD and CORS_ORIGINS are correctly read from env (no hardcoded secrets).
All Mongo `_id` fields are excluded from responses — good.

CORS uses allow_credentials=True with `*` origin from env — works in dev because frontend uses Bearer header, but if you ever rely solely on cookies in prod set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend URL (browsers reject `*` + credentials).
Deletion of a student cascades to fees / attendance / complaints and pulls them from room occupants — solid.
Attendance has unique index on (student_id, date) and uses upsert — idempotent, good.
PDF generation works in-process via reportlab; on heavy load consider a background task — fine for college project.
test_credentials: admin@hostel.edu / admin123 (seeded). Staff/student created at runtime by admin.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient data with uuid-suffixed emails/roll_no/room_no and clean up at end (TestZCleanup). No persistent test pollution beyond a few rooms/students left from earlier failed runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_hostel_api.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_hostel_api.py -v`. Toast/overlay timing was the only quirk during UI tests; mitigated by waiting 5s after login/save before clicking next action button. All 3 roles (admin/staff/student) seed/login flow validated end-to-end. Project PDF endpoint returns valid `%PDF` binary.
rca of the issue: Toast container in App.js (sonner) defaults to top-right and floats over the page header where the primary CTA button lives. With richColors+default duration ~4s, the toast covers buttons like `Add Room` and `Add Student` for ~4-5s after any successful action. Mitigation: move <Toaster position="bottom-right" /> or set duration shorter, or shift page action buttons to left.
